title: Simultaneous affine etale source and two-arrow descent without coverings
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder, $D:I^{op}\to\mathrm{Scheme}$ a diagram of qcqs schemes with affine transitions and $c$ a limit cone with apex $X$. Fix $i_0\in I$, an affine etale object $W$ over $D(i_0)$ [def-weil-pbc-full-affine-etale-site], and $n\in\mathbb N$. For each $q\in\mathrm{Fin}(n)$ let $V_q$ be an affine etale object over $X$, let $U_q$ be an arbitrary etale object over $D(i_0)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and give arrows $a_q:V_q\to p_{i_0}^*W$ and $b_q:V_q\to p_{i_0}^*U_q$. No covering condition is imposed. There exist $j\in\mathrm{Over}(op\,i_0)$, affine etale objects $V_{j,q}$, arrows $a_{j,q}:V_{j,q}\to f_j^*W$, $b_{j,q}:V_{j,q}\to f_j^*U_q$ and isomorphisms $d_q:p_j^*V_{j,q}\cong V_q$, with $p_j^*a_{j,q}\gg e_j(W)^{-1}=d_q\gg a_q$ and $p_j^*b_{j,q}\gg e_j(U_q)^{-1}=d_q\gg b_q$, where $e_j(Z):p_{i_0}^*Z\cong p_j^*f_j^*Z$ is the canonical pullback-composition comparison and $\gg$ denotes diagrammatic composition. No covering conclusion is asserted.

proof.text: Use affineEtale_common_models to descend the finite family of affine etale sources. Choose a stage above both the model stage and i₀, and base change each model there. isPullback_isPullbackLift retains the cartesian comparisons with the original V_q.

For each chosen affine source model, form its base-change diagram and limiting cone. Its terms are qcqs and its transitions affine. For each of the two target families (W and U_q), compose the original arrow with the first projection to the target, transporting through the source pullback isomorphism. Apply Scheme.exists_π_app_comp_eq_of_locallyOfFinitePresentation over D(i₀). Only local finite presentation of the etale targets is required. Index the two families by Fin(n) times Bool and use IsCofiltered.inf_objs_exists to choose one common stage, transporting the factorized maps by diagram transitions. This also works for the empty family.

Construct the stage etale arrows by pullback.lift from the descended scheme maps and the source structure morphisms. The factorization structure equations ensure these lifts are over the stage. Base change preserves affine sources. Define d_q using the same cartesian source square for both arrows. Prove each displayed equation by pullback.hom_ext: its first projection is the factorization equation, after computing the pullback-composition comparison and the common source comparison; its second projection follows because both composites are morphisms over the limit.

theorem etale_finiteFactorizationDataDescent
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, CompactSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a)]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c) (i₀ : I)
    (W : (D.obj (op i₀)).FullAffineEtale)
    (n : ℕ) (V : Fin n → c.pt.Etale)
    (a : ∀ q, V q ⟶
      (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (c.π.app (op i₀))).obj W.obj)
    (U : Fin n → (D.obj (op i₀)).Etale)
    (b : ∀ q, V q ⟶
      (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (c.π.app (op i₀))).obj (U q))
    (hV : ∀ q, IsAffine (V q).left) :
    let B := fun j : Over (op i₀) ↦ MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (c.π.app j.left)
    let F := fun j : Over (op i₀) ↦ MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (D.map j.hom)
    let e := fun (j : Over (op i₀)) (Z : (D.obj (op i₀)).Etale) ↦
      (MorphismProperty.Over.pullbackComp (P := @Etale) (Q := ⊤)
        (c.π.app j.left) (D.map j.hom) (c.π.app (op i₀)) (c.w j.hom).symm).app Z
    ∃ (j : Over (op i₀)) (Vj : Fin n → (D.obj j.left).Etale)
      (aj : ∀ q, Vj q ⟶ (F j).obj W.obj)
      (bj : ∀ q, Vj q ⟶ (F j).obj (U q))
      (d : ∀ q, (B j).obj (Vj q) ≅ V q),
      (∀ q, IsAffine (Vj q).left) ∧
      (∀ q, (B j).map (aj q) ≫ (e j W.obj).inv = (d q).hom ≫ a q) ∧
      (∀ q, (B j).map (bj q) ≫ (e j (U q)).inv = (d q).hom ≫ b q)
